◆ simulate()

bool borderLine::simulate ( bool  exhaustive = false,
UINT  maxlevel = 0 
)
inline

Run the algorithm non-interactively.

Parameters
falsebool exhaustive= If true, the minimization steps will explore the combinatory space systematically.
0UINT maxlevel= How many simultaneous exchanges should be explored. A value of zero checks all pairwise exchanges. A value of one explores all two-pair exchanges, and so on. The maximum value is floor(nregions / 2). Values higher than that are treated as that value.
Returns
bool Returns true on completion

The use of this function in exhaustive mode may require large amounts of computation and memory. The increase of those requirements with maxlevel are very steep. It is recommended to run estimateExhaustiveTime() to check whether this is feasible.
